text:
alex.devex: Quick sync — RC1 cutover scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need to lock SDK uploads, docs freeze, sample apps snapshot, and changelog cut. Who's owning each?

maria.docs: I can own docs freeze. Plan: create `rc1` branch and snapshot site by 9:00am PT. Will accept any last-minute doc PRs til 8:30.

sam.sdk: I'll handle npm/pypi publish. ETA: 10:15am PT (publish script calls are flaky atm). Need final changelog entry and tag pushed by 10:05. Ping me when tag is up.

jordan.eng: I'll clear the remaining review queue for the SDK: PRs #514, #519, #523. Can push reviews by EOD today. If anyone needs priority, drop a note.

tyler.release: I can run post-publish smoke and trigger canary rollout. Need the docker image tag and the build artifact path.

olivia.prod: Reminder: Dedicated customers need a config migration note in the changelog. Maria, can you include a short blurb?

alex.devex: Owners summary (please confirm):
- SDK publish: sam.sdk
- Docs freeze + site snapshot: maria.docs
- Sample apps snapshot & release notes: jordan.eng + alex.devex
- Changelog collate: sam.sdk + olivia.prod
- Smoke tests + canary: tyler.release

sam.sdk: Confirmed for publish. Will run `npm publish && twine upload dist/*` and post the output in this thread.

maria.docs: Confirmed for docs. I'll add a migration note for Dedicated under "upgrade notes".

jordan.eng: I can snapshot the sample apps at 9:30am PT and open a release PR with the exact commit SHAs. Will also update quickstart READMEs.

tyler.release: I'll queue the smoke test job. Need the artifact URL like: `gs://redwood-artifacts/rc1/sdk-1.2.0.tgz` (or docker tag). Sam, please paste after publish.

ci-bot: build-redwood-sdk #198 passed (commit abc123). Artifacts: gs://redwood-artifacts/ci/abc123/

sam.sdk: changelog snippet for entry (please review):
```
SDK: Add `streaming` flag to Redwood client. Breaking: default timeout lowered to 30s for non-streaming requests.
Migration: if you rely on long-polling behavior, set `timeout_ms` in client config.
```

olivia.prod: LGTM, but add one line: "Dedicated: update gateway timeout to match client timeout".

sam.sdk: updated snippet above. Will append to CHANGELOG.md and push tag `v1.2.0-rc1` at 10:02am PT.

alex.devex: A couple quick blockers we should call out:
- Docs: any API surface changes that need code samples updated? (maria.docs)
- Sample apps: ensure CI passes with the new runtime flags (jordan.eng)
- Release notes: include known regressions with workarounds (olivia.prod)

maria.docs: I saw the `timeout_ms` param; will scan code samples and update a couple lines. No major surface changes.

jordan.eng: Running local CI against my snapshot branch now. If tests fail, will raise a blockers thread by 6pm PT.

alex.devex: Code review pings — tagging reviewers: @jordan.eng please prioritize #519, it's blocking sample app tests. @tyler.release can you review the canary policy PR when it's up?

jordan.eng: On it, will review this afternoon.

tyler.release: Will review canary policy first thing tomorrow AM if it's open tonight.

sam.sdk: FYI publish checklist snippet (copy-paste):
1) Ensure CHANGELOG updated with entry
2) Tag repo: `git tag -a v1.2.0-rc1 -m "RC1"`
3) CI artifacts present at gs://redwood-artifacts/ci/<sha>/
4) Run `npm publish` (npm) and `twine upload dist/*` (pypi)
5) Post artifact URLs and docker tag to this thread

alex.devex: Timing plan: 09:00 docs snapshot, 09:30 sample app snapshot, 10:00 tag + push, 10:15 publish, 10:30 smoke tests. If publish slips beyond 10:30 we push cutover back 30m. Everyone ok? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria.docs: ok for docs timing.

jordan.eng: ok here.

ci-bot: nightly-e2e #57 queued -> running (sample-apps).

sam.sdk: tagging now: pushed `v1.2.0-rc1` (git sha abc123). Publishing in ~2m.

sam.sdk: npm publish output: OK - version 1.2.0-rc1 published. PyPI upload: OK. Artifacts: gs://redwood-artifacts/ci/abc123/sdk-1.2.0-rc1.tgz

tyler.release: Got artifact URL. Kicking off smoke tests now.

tyler.release: Smoke tests: all green (small flakiness on embed tests but within baseline). Starting canary rollout.

alex.devex: Thanks everyone. Two follow-ups: maria, will you merge docs rc branch after smoke green? sam, can you post final changelog PR link?

maria.docs: will merge after Tyler confirms canary health is stable for 15m.

sam.sdk: changelog PR: https://git.redwood/changes/PR-612 (contains snippets and Dedicated note).

jordan.eng: sample apps snapshot PR: https://git.redwood/sampleapps/PR-89

olivia.prod: Noted. I'll kick off customer comms draft once docs merged.

alex.devex: Perfect. If anyone hits an unblocker after hours, drop it here and we'll triage. :rocket:
